sections.title: Remove a member handler
sections.what: Takes the signed-in caller as the owner, removes the named member from the named crew, and returns an empty success response.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the owner remove action.
sections.watch_out: The route trusts the removal service to confirm the caller really owns the crew.

summary: Lets a crew owner remove a member from the crew, using the crew and member ids from the address.
purpose: Gives crew owners control over who is in their crew.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the remove button for owners.
how: 1) Confirms the caller is signed in and treats them as the owner. 2) Reads the crew and member ids from the address. 3) Calls the removal service. 4) Returns an empty success response.
inputs: A DELETE request with crew and member ids in the address. The caller comes from the session.
outputs: An empty 204 response when removal succeeds.
risks: This route does not check ownership itself, so the removal service must refuse non-owners.
debug: If removal fails for an owner, check the owner rules in the crews service.
